207950119_dadc8575.text: .The principal catecholaminergic neurotransmitter phenotype in TH-expressing nuclei was confirmed by cross-referencing our TH imaging data (Fig. 1E,F) with in situ mRNA hybridization data imported from the Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (https://mouse.brain-map. org). These included transcriptional markers of dopaminergic (TH and dopamine transporter) and noradrenergic (dopamine beta- hydroxylase and noradrenaline transporter) neurons (Fig. S1).
